name: Red Hat OpenShift
certifications: Red Hat Certified OpenShift Application Developer (EX288)
Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Virtualization
tools: OpenShift Container Platform 4 or OpenShift Local
Quay or the internal image registry

beginner.summary: For developers and operations engineers who deploy and run applications on Red Hat OpenShift. Covers what OpenShift adds to Kubernetes, lab environments and the oc CLI, projects and the web console, deploying from images and source with Source-to-Image, deployments, services and routes, configuration, persistent storage, image streams, health checks, scaling, quotas and limits, security context constraints, RBAC, templates and Helm, operators, logging and monitoring for application teams and troubleshooting with oc.
prerequisites: Uses Linux on the command line
Understands containers and has built a container image
Basic Kubernetes knowledge helps but is not required
outcomes: Deploy applications on OpenShift from images, source and Helm charts
Expose, configure, store data for and scale applications with routes, ConfigMaps, Secrets and PVCs
Run workloads within quotas, security context constraints and RBAC
Monitor and troubleshoot applications with the console and oc

days.topic: OpenShift Overview: Kubernetes, Red Hat Additions and Editions
subtopics: What OpenShift is and how it relates to Kubernetes
What OpenShift adds: routes, builds, operators and security defaults
OpenShift Container Platform, OKD and managed editions
Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS and Azure Red Hat OpenShift
The web console's developer and administrator views
The oc CLI compared with kubectl
Course project overview: a three-tier application
days.lab_task: Log in to a lab cluster, explore the developer and administrator views, list projects and nodes with oc and write a one-page comparison of OpenShift and plain Kubernetes.
checks: The console and oc both reach the cluster
Developer and administrator views are described

days.topic: Lab Setup: OpenShift Local, Developer Sandbox and the oc CLI
subtopics: Lab options: OpenShift Local, Developer Sandbox and shared clusters
days.lab_task: Set up OpenShift Local or a Developer Sandbox account, install oc, log in with a token, switch between two contexts and deploy a test application.
checks: oc and the lab cluster work

days.topic: Projects, Users and the Web Console
subtopics: Default roles: admin, edit and view
days.lab_task: Create dev and test projects, give a partner edit rights in one and view rights in the other, and use the topology view to explore a deployed application.
checks: The partner has edit and view rights as planned
The topology view shows the application

days.topic: Deploying Applications from Images
subtopics: Image pull secrets for private registries
days.lab_task: Deploy the course API from a private registry image with a pull secret, set environment variables, update the image tag and remove the application cleanly with labels.
checks: The private image is pulled with the secret

days.topic: Source-to-Image Builds and BuildConfigs
subtopics: Build triggers: webhooks, config and image changes
days.lab_task: Build the course web application from source with Source-to-Image, trigger a rebuild from a Git webhook and compare it with a Dockerfile strategy build.
checks: The S2I build produces a running application
A Git push triggers a new build
S2I and Dockerfile builds are compared

days.topic: Deployments, Pods and ReplicaSets on OpenShift
subtopics: DeploymentConfig and why to avoid it now
days.lab_task: Deploy the API with a rolling strategy and an init container, roll out a bad version, roll back and explain why new work should use Deployments.
checks: The new version rolls out with zero downtime
The rollback restores the working version
The note on DeploymentConfig is correct

days.topic: Services and Routes: Exposing Applications
days.lab_task: Expose the web application with an edge TLS route and the API with a re-encrypt route, add a path-based route and split traffic between two versions.
days.deliverable: Routes with TLS and traffic split
checks: Both applications are reachable through routes
Traffic divides between versions as configured

days.topic: Configuration with ConfigMaps and Secrets
subtopics: What not to put in ConfigMaps
days.lab_task: Move the API's configuration into a ConfigMap and its database password into a Secret, mount a config file, change a value and roll the pods to pick it up.
checks: No configuration is baked into the image
The config file appears in the container
The changed value is used after restart

days.topic: Persistent Storage: PVCs and Storage Classes
days.lab_task: Deploy the database as a StatefulSet with a PVC, write data, delete the pod and confirm the data survives, then expand the volume.
checks: The PVC is bound by a storage class

days.topic: Image Streams and the Internal Registry
subtopics: Image streams compared with direct references
days.lab_task: Import an external image into an image stream, trigger a deployment on tag change, promote an image from dev to test with a tag and prune old images.
checks: The external image appears in the stream
A tag change rolls out the deployment
The image is promoted to test

days.topic: Health Checks: Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes
days.lab_task: Add readiness, liveness and startup probes to the API, show traffic stopping to an unready pod and a stuck pod being restarted, and fix a probe that restarts healthy pods.
checks: Unready pods leave service and stuck pods restart
The bad probe no longer restarts healthy pods

days.topic: Scaling and Autoscaling Applications

days.topic: Resource Requests, Limits, Quotas and LimitRanges
days.lab_task: Set requests and limits for the application, apply a project quota and a LimitRange, trigger and fix an out-of-memory kill, and read quota usage.
checks: Requests and limits are set from measurements

days.topic: Security Context Constraints and Running as Non-Root

days.deliverable: Fixed image running under restricted SCC
checks: The failure is traced to user and permission settings

days.topic: RBAC: Roles, Role Bindings and Groups
subtopics: Checking access with oc auth can-i

can-i confirms allowed and denied actions

days.topic: Templates and Helm Charts in OpenShift
subtopics: Helm charts in the developer catalog

days.deliverable: Template and Helm deployments with a decision

days.topic: Operators and OperatorHub
subtopics: OperatorHub and the Operator Lifecycle Manager
Operator scope: one namespace or all

checks: The operator is installed and healthy

days.topic: Logging and Monitoring for Application Teams
subtopics: Pod logs in the console and with oc
days.lab_task: Expose application metrics, enable a ServiceMonitor for the API, create an alert for high error rates and investigate an incident with logs and events.
checks: Application metrics appear in the console
The error-rate alert fires during a test

days.topic: Troubleshooting Applications with oc
subtopics: Pod statuses and what they mean
oc logs for current and previous containers
Image pull and crash loop problems
days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix five broken deployments (image pull error, crash loop, failing probe, missing secret and quota block) with oc and write a troubleshooting checklist.
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
The checklist covers the commands used

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Deploying a Three-Tier Application on OpenShift
days.lab_task: Deploy the course's web, API and database tiers with S2I, routes with TLS, externalised configuration, persistent storage, probes, autoscaling, quotas and monitoring, all under the restricted SCC.
checks: All three tiers run and are reachable
Quotas, SCCs and RBAC are in place

intermediate.summary: For administrators and platform engineers who run OpenShift clusters for teams, aligned with the EX280 and EX288 skills. Covers cluster architecture, authentication, OVN-Kubernetes networking and network policies, ingress controllers and certificates, cluster operators and updates, machine sets and autoscaling, storage operators, OpenShift Pipelines, OpenShift GitOps, builds, team self-service, cluster monitoring, logging, backup with OADP, certificate and secret management, the Compliance Operator, developer tools, service mesh and serverless.
prerequisites: Deploys and troubleshoots applications on OpenShift
Comfortable with Linux administration and YAML
Has cluster-admin access to a lab cluster
outcomes: Administer OpenShift clusters: identity, networking, ingress, nodes, storage and updates
Provide teams with pipelines, GitOps and self-service projects
Monitor, log, back up and secure clusters with OpenShift operators
Prepare for the EX280 and EX288 exams

days.topic: Cluster Architecture: Control Plane, Workers and Machine Config
days.lab_task: Map the lab cluster's control plane, workers, machine config pools and cluster operators, and apply a safe machine config change to a worker pool.
days.deliverable: Cluster architecture map and a machine config change
checks: Nodes, pools and operators are documented
The machine config rolls out to the pool
The roles of CoreOS and the operator are explained

days.topic: Authentication: Identity Providers, OAuth and Groups
days.lab_task: Configure an HTPasswd and an OpenID Connect identity provider, sync groups, map groups to roles and remove the kubeadmin user safely.
checks: Users log in through both providers
Group membership grants the right roles

days.lab_task: Apply default-deny network policies to a project, allow only the web-to-API-to-database paths, restrict egress to one external service and test connectivity.
checks: Only the approved external service is reachable

days.topic: Ingress Controllers, Route Sharding and TLS Certificates
days.lab_task: Add a second ingress controller for internal routes with sharding, issue certificates with cert-manager and rotate a route certificate without downtime.
checks: Internal routes use the second controller

days.topic: Cluster Operators, Updates and Upgrade Channels

days.lab_task: Check update readiness for the lab cluster, pick a path in the update graph, run a minor update while watching operators and pools, and write an update runbook.
checks: The update completes with healthy operators
The runbook records steps and checks

days.topic: Machine Sets, Node Scaling and Cluster Autoscaler
days.lab_task: Scale a machine set, add a machine health check, enable the cluster autoscaler for one machine set and drain a node safely for maintenance.
days.deliverable: Node scaling setup with maintenance evidence
checks: The machine set adds and removes nodes

The team sees only its applications

days.topic: Builds at Scale: Builds for Red Hat OpenShift and Build Strategies

days.lab_task: Build the application with a Shipwright-based build using Buildah, push to an external registry and compare time and security with the BuildConfig build.

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Team Platform on OpenShift with Pipelines and GitOps
days.lab_task: Build a team platform on a lab cluster with identity, self-service projects, network policies, sharded ingress, Tekton pipelines, GitOps delivery, monitoring, logging, backups and a compliance scan, and onboard a team.
checks: A team onboards and deploys through pipelines and GitOps
Network policies and compliance results meet the targets

advanced.summary: For senior administrators, architects and platform leads who run OpenShift across an organisation. Covers multi-cluster management with ACM, Advanced Cluster Security, OpenShift Virtualization and VM migration from VMware, managed OpenShift on AWS and Azure, hosted control planes, disconnected installations, installation methods, day-two operations, capacity and cost, high availability and disaster recovery, etcd operations, writing operators, OpenShift AI, platform engineering with Developer Hub, regulated workloads, edge deployments, upgrades at scale and cluster troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Holds EX280 or has equivalent experience
Responsible for platform design, security or operations
outcomes: Design and manage fleets of OpenShift clusters across data centres, clouds and edge
Secure clusters and workloads with ACS, compliance and regulated configurations
Run virtual machines and AI workloads on OpenShift
Operate upgrades, capacity, recovery and troubleshooting at scale

days.topic: Multi-Cluster Management with Advanced Cluster Management
subtopics: Why manage clusters as a fleet
days.lab_task: Import two clusters into ACM, group them in cluster sets, apply a governance policy to both and deliver an application to one set by placement.
days.deliverable: Managed fleet with policies and placement
checks: The policy reports compliance on both clusters
The application lands only on the chosen set

days.topic: Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Install ACS, block a deployment with a critical vulnerability by policy, add an image check to CI and investigate a runtime alert from a simulated attack.

days.topic: OpenShift Virtualization: Running VMs Next to Containers

days.deliverable: Running VM with migration and backup
checks: The VM runs and is reachable

days.topic: Migrating VMs from VMware to OpenShift Virtualization
days.lab_task: Assess a small VMware inventory, map networks and storage, run a warm migration of one VM, test it and plan the remaining waves.
checks: VMs are rated for migration readiness
The warm migration completes and the VM works
The wave plan covers the remaining VMs

days.topic: Managed OpenShift: ROSA, ARO and OpenShift Dedicated
subtopics: Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS
Networking with cloud VPCs and VNets
days.lab_task: Create a managed OpenShift cluster on AWS or Azure, connect it to a private network, integrate cloud identity and compare responsibilities and costs with self-managed.
checks: The managed cluster runs in a private network

days.topic: Hosted Control Planes
subtopics: When to use hosted control planes
days.lab_task: Create a hosted cluster on a management cluster, add a node pool, upgrade the hosted control plane separately from the workers and compare resource use with a standalone cluster.
checks: Control plane and node pools upgrade separately
Resource use is compared with a standalone cluster

days.topic: Disconnected and Air-Gapped Installations
subtopics: Why some clusters cannot reach the internet
days.lab_task: Mirror a release and two operators with oc-mirror into a mirror registry, configure a disconnected cluster to use it and run an update from the mirror.
checks: Release and operator content is in the mirror

days.topic: Cluster Installation Methods: IPI, UPI and Agent-Based
days.lab_task: Install a cluster with the agent-based installer in a lab, validate it with checks, and compare installation methods for three environments.
checks: Methods are matched to environments with reasons

days.topic: Day-Two Operations at Scale

checks: Service levels and health checks are defined

days.topic: Capacity Planning and Cost Management for OpenShift
days.lab_task: Analyse requests against real use across projects, find overprovisioned workloads, set an overcommit policy and produce a showback report with a growth forecast.

days.topic: High Availability and Disaster Recovery Across Clusters
days.lab_task: Design active-passive recovery for an application across two clusters, replicate its data, fail over traffic in a drill and rebuild the failed cluster from GitOps.
checks: The design meets the recovery objectives
Traffic moves to the second cluster
The failed cluster is rebuilt from Git

days.topic: etcd Operations: Backup, Defragmentation and Recovery
subtopics: Replacing a failed control plane node
days.lab_task: Take an etcd backup, check health and fragmentation, defragment safely and practise replacing a failed control plane node in a lab cluster.
checks: The control plane node is replaced
objectives: Back up and restore control planes

days.topic: Regulated Workloads: FIPS, Compliance and Audit
days.lab_task: Configure a cluster for a regulated workload with FIPS mode, compliance profiles, audit log forwarding and separation of duties, and answer an auditor's questions from evidence.
checks: FIPS and compliance settings are applied
